summary: Reviewed PR #129 for gitignore correctness, template/pack drift, SETUP.md staleness, symlink integrity, and tracked-vs-ignored consistency. All 22 symlinks are valid. The core gitignore logic works correctly (negations function as intended). Found one critical issue: pack/SETUP.md -- the install guide read by every new repo -- describes loop/learnings.jsonl as a versioned file and handoffs/ as gitignored, both now wrong. Found multiple warnings: stale learnings.jsonl references persist in CLAUDE.md, host.md, SKILL.md, handoffs.md, pack.md (files touched in this PR), plus infrastructure scripts and orchestrator runtime code; deleted skills/github/ still referenced in pack.md, MANIFEST.json, integrator.md, and SETUP.md.
goal: Review gitignore rules, template/pack drift, and SETUP.md for regressions in PR #129

findings.issue: SETUP.md tree describes loop/ contents that no longer match reality. Line 59 lists 'learnings.jsonl  append-only events (version this)' but that file was deleted in this PR and its gitignore negation removed. Line 54 says 'handoffs/  per-run; gitignored' but !loop/handoffs/ un-ignores them and 31 handoff JSONs are tracked. Line 82/105/108 reference skills/github/ which was deleted. SETUP.md is the install guide copied to every new repo via init-pack; following it produces a wrong setup.
findings.fix: Remove learnings.jsonl from the tree. Change handoffs/ description to 'orchestrator retro reads these; tracked'. Remove skills/github/ references. Add a note that !loop/*.md tracks all .md files under loop/.

findings.issue: CLAUDE.md (modified in this PR) still says 'Persist read-only agents learnings into loop/learnings.jsonl'. The new learning-loop.md says learnings go in handoff arrays only and are promoted to permanent docs by the orchestrator retro. learnings.jsonl is deleted and gitignored. Agents following CLAUDE.md will write to a file that vanishes on clone.
findings.fix: Change to 'Persist read-only agents learnings via their handoff learnings arrays' or similar wording matching the new promote-then-prune model.

findings.issue: host.md (modified in this PR) references learnings.jsonl on line 18 ('Memory | loop/learnings.md + loop/learnings.jsonl') and line 55 ('loop/learnings.jsonl are persistent memory'). The file was deleted.
findings.fix: Remove learnings.jsonl from the memory table and runtime section. Memory is now loop/learnings.md (open questions only) plus the permanent docs that promoted learnings live in.

findings.issue: SKILL.md (modified in this PR) still instructs agents to 'fold new loop/learnings.jsonl entries' (line 80) and 'Append your new learnings to loop/learnings.jsonl' (line 115). Contradicts the rewritten learning-loop.md.
findings.fix: Line 80: change retro step to reference handoff learnings arrays. Line 115: remove the learnings.jsonl instruction, keep 'put cross-agent findings in the handoff learnings array'.

findings.issue: handoffs.md says 'Each learning here MUST also be appended (one line) to loop/learnings.jsonl'. File was deleted; the new model promotes from handoff arrays directly.
findings.fix: Remove the learnings.jsonl append requirement. The handoff learnings array is the sole record; the orchestrator retro promotes from there.

findings.issue: pack.md (modified in this PR) references learnings.jsonl in the layer diagram (line 42), the 'what stays' list (line 81), and references deleted agents/github.md and skills/github/SKILL.md (lines 189, 208).
findings.fix: Update layer 4 to remove learnings.jsonl. Update line 81 to remove learnings.jsonl. Remove or update github references.

findings.issue: The learnings array description says 'each is also appended to loop/learnings.jsonl'. This schema is synced to .cursor/ and .claude/ via symlinks.
findings.fix: Remove the learnings.jsonl clause from the description.

findings.issue: init-pack.mjs creates an empty learnings.jsonl when initializing a new repo. The file serves no purpose in the new promote-then-prune model.
findings.fix: Remove the learnings.jsonl creation. Only create learnings.md.

findings.issue: pack-copy.mjs emits '!loop/learnings.jsonl' in the gitignore negation list. This negation is no longer needed.
findings.fix: Replace with !loop/handoffs/ and !loop/*.md to match the current gitignore.snippet.

findings.issue: export-template.mjs creates an empty learnings.jsonl in the template destination. No longer needed.
doNotCopy list includes 'loop/learnings.jsonl'. The file no longer exists. Also missing from doNotCopy: loop/*.md files (design.md, spec.md, etc.) which are product-specific and should not be copied.
findings.fix: Remove the learnings.jsonl entry. Consider adding loop/*.md to doNotCopy.

findings.issue: Integrator agent references 'agents/github.md / skills/github' for stacked-PR delegation. Both were deleted in this PR.
findings.fix: Remove the github subagent dispatch instruction or replace with alternative guidance for stacked PRs.

findings.issue: The comment says 'loop/* with negation to keep learnings.md (open questions only)' but the !loop/*.md rule keeps ALL .md files under loop/ (11 files currently tracked: design.md, spec.md, architecture.md, etc.). The comment understates the actual behavior. Same in pack/templates/gitignore.snippet.
findings.fix: Update comment to mention that all .md files and handoffs/ are tracked, not just learnings.md.

findings.issue: .cursor/loop/*.md line exists in .gitignore but is absent from pack/templates/gitignore.snippet. Pre-existing drift, not introduced by this PR.
findings.fix: Add .cursor/loop/*.md to the template snippet, or remove from .gitignore if .cursor/loop/ is no longer used.

learnings.insight: When changing a data model (learnings.jsonl -> promote-then-prune), all references to the old model must be updated in the same change. 15+ files still reference learnings.jsonl after learning-loop.md was rewritten to remove it.
learnings.action: grep the old concept name across the entire repo before marking the migration complete.

learnings.insight: pack/SETUP.md, pack/MANIFEST.json, and scripts/ form an infrastructure layer that must stay consistent with gitignore and learning model changes.
learnings.action: When changing gitignore negations or deleting tracked artifacts, also update SETUP.md tree, MANIFEST.json doNotCopy, init-pack.mjs, export-template.mjs, and pack-copy.mjs.
